text: defineAttribute builds a database identity from extensionName + ":" + attributeName. Its documentation permits bindName to override the exposed property name and warns that binding names need to avoid collisions. A scoped naming recommendation is to keep persistence identity and public object property roles distinct; changing a display label does not justify changing either key.
